title: GitHub Actions
description: Runs a service's generated workflow, which calls the platform's pinned reusable workflow and signs images keyless; runs STEGO's own suites and gates, and keeps the proof run and release verdict attestations its attestation action signs.

title: Konflux
description: Runs the Konflux standard pipeline from a service's generated PipelineRun, with the STEGO checks, and signs images with Tekton Chains.

title: Argo CD
description: Reads a service's delivery object, Kubernetes base and the platform's overlay from git, and applies them.
